# Saikat Roy

> Senior Backend Engineer at YOUR Campus in Dhaka, Bangladesh, on the core team since day zero. Builds the backends behind real-world commerce: Django and REST API backends for smart vending, campus laundry and e-commerce platforms, plus Shopify and WordPress stores for freelance clients. Backend-leaning full stack: pairs Django with React and Next.js frontends.

Machine-readable summaries: this file (/llms.txt) and the full text of the site in Markdown at https://saikatroy.netlify.app/llms-full.txt

## Core skills

Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, PHP, HTML5, CSS3, Django, Django REST Framework, Next.js, React, REST API Design, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, DigitalOcean, Docker, Nginx, Linux, Git & CI/CD, WordPress, Shopify.

## Experience

- Senior Backend Engineer, YOUR Campus (Mar 2022–Present) — core team from day zero; builds the backend of an IoT campus-services platform with 135,000+ app users across 21 universities (285+ app-controlled washing machines, 160+ smart vending machines): YOUR Laundry, YOUR Shop, YOUR Mart, YOUR Locker, YOUR Planet, YOUR Printer (in development), plus bKash/Nagad/SSLCommerz/aamarPay payment integration. Case study: https://saikatroy.netlify.app/work/your-campus
- Web Developer, Upwork & Fiverr freelance (May 2021–Present) — WordPress redesigns, Shopify theme customization (Liquid), data and site migrations, responsive frontend fixes, WooCommerce, speed/SEO fixes and landing pages for clients worldwide. Case study: https://saikatroy.netlify.app/work/freelance
- Junior Software Developer, Germania Holdings Ltd. (Jul 2021–Nov 2022) — part of the team that built SnacKeeper, a 24/7 smart vending network in Dhaka with bKash payments (Python, PHP, MySQL); SnacKeeper later moved to YOUR Campus. Case study: https://saikatroy.netlify.app/work/snackeeper
- Executive Developer, Dokmi BD (Aug 2020–Jun 2021) — WordPress, Shopify and frontend development.

## Products built

- HisabBD — free English & Bangla calculators for Bangladesh: https://bd-hisab.vercel.app
- Hottogol — funny Bangladeshi simulators and games: https://hottogol.vercel.app
- BD Rail Ticket Alarm — Brave/Chrome extension that alerts you when Bangladesh Railway tickets open: https://saikatnjm.github.io/bd-rail-ticket-alarm/
- BD Price Compare — Chrome extension comparing prices across Bangladeshi online stores by unit price: https://saikatnjm.github.io/bd-price-compare/
- Bangladesh Healthcare Search — medicines, hospitals, clinics and pharmacies: https://bdhealthsearch.vercel.app
- Pujo Guide — bilingual Durga Puja and Bengali festival guide: https://pujoguide.vercel.app
